entries.title: The Rusty Flagon
entries.text: A warm, busy tavern on Phandalin's town green, run by the halfling barkeep Marta.

entries.title: Marta
entries.text: Halfling barkeep and owner of the Rusty Flagon. Sharp-eyed, practical, and protective of her furniture. Welcomed the party.

entries.title: The stool that started it
entries.text: Lyra threw one of Marta's bar stools at Bruno the bouncer, smashing it across his chest. The scarred mercenary jumped up gleefully and a brawl broke out in the Rusty Flagon.

entries.title: Skinny Jo knocked out
entries.text: In the middle of the brawl, Lyra knocked out Skinny Jo, one of the scarred mercenary's crew, with the pommel of her dagger.

entries.title: Gruk knocked out
entries.text: Thorin flattened Gruk Tannerson with the flat of his longsword, knocking the mercenary out cold in the middle of the brawl. Dagger Dan looks ready to bolt.

entries.title: Dagger Dan gives up
entries.text: With Gruk and Skinny Jo knocked out, Dagger Dan raised his hands and surrendered. Marta wants someone to pay for her broken stool.

entries.title: Bruno
entries.text: The Rusty Flagon's huge, calm bouncer. Took a thrown stool to the chest from Lyra and wants a quiet explanation.
